summary.text: Calvin Horn is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 76, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican Matt Reisetter.
Horn is retired and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Calvin Horn earned a high school diploma from Cedar Falls High School and, as of 2026, was retired.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he listed among his key messages funding public schools and fairly compensating teachers, researching the causes of Iowa's cancer rates, and reducing nitrates in streams and rivers.
